Clause 2.2 - heritage (heritage_protection): (h) land, places, buildings or structures listed on the State Heritage Register under the Heritage Act 1977, or

Clause 2.2 - zoning (land_use_zoning): Words and expressions used in this Chapter have (subject to this section) the same meaning as they have in the standard local environmental planning instrument prescribed by the Standard Instrument (Local Environmental Plans) Order 2006.

Clause 2.2 - environmental_protection (environmental_protection): (i) land reserved or dedicated under the Crown Land Management Act 2016 for the preservation of flora, fauna, geological formations or for other environmental protection purposes, or

Clause 2.2 - environmental_protection (environmental_protection): (j) land identified as being critical habitat under the Threatened Species Conservation Act 1995 or Part 7A of the Fisheries Management Act 1994.

Clause 2.5 - other (land_use_zoning): Subject to section 74(1) of the Act, in the event of an inconsistency between this Chapter and another environmental planning instrument, whether made before or after the commencement of this Chapter, this Chapter prevails to the extent of the inconsistency.
